Peaceful tasteful spot away from the main road riverside bedlum!
Sep 2026 • Solo
The main road outside is bedlam and persistently noisy however cafe RuNam Dong Khoi is a haven away from all that. Tastefully decorated in an Art Deco / belle époque style with a huge bar! Open all day for breakfast lunch and dinners. The hot/cold drinks menu alone is impressive. Also for sale is a collection of coffees and phin filter cups. Great for gifts to take home. Service is excellent and ambience is restful in this busy and competitive area along the riverside. Close to the water taxi stop and statue stop on the hop on/off bus tour. Part of a chain all over Saigon but this one has character.

Good for meetings over coffee
Aug 2025 • Business
I go to RuNam Bistro on Đồng Khởi quite often for meetings over coffee, and it has become one of my favorite spots in Ho Chi Minh City. The atmosphere is classy yet relaxed, making it perfect for conversations over coffee or a light meal. The staff are professional and attentive, and they always make sure things run smoothly without interrupting. The food is consistently good, with a nice mix of Vietnamese and Western options, and their coffee is excellent. The location in the city center is very convenient. It’s a reliable place I can count on for both work and leisure.

Fabulous food, service, ambience!
Mar 2025 • Friends
Located right across from Ben Bach Dang Express Boat dock, this wonderful restaurant is a true gem! We enjoyed a fabulous lunch here on a very warm day in Saigon. Beautiful setting, gorgeous décor, fresh flowers on table, calm chill out ambience, and the cool AC created such a welcoming experience. We had grilled steak (served with small green salad), seafood bow (with slices of bread to mop up the broth), and com tam bi (rice with grilled pork and pickled veggies). Such a gourmet, tasty and delightful feast! We also ordered a variety of elective desserts to try. We loved the glass jelly coconut dessert drink and avocado smoothie with coconut ice cream. Attentive to tastes and ingredients were so obvious in all the dishes. We were really impressed with the young, friendly, helpful serving staff. All speak English perfectly! Highly recommend.
